overview: Learn to run your own Amazon listings and ads. We teach on video calls using your real account, so every lesson is about your products. Topics are keyword research, writing listings, reading search term reports, setting bids and budgets, and spotting policy risks. You get call notes, a short checklist for each topic and a recording you can share with your team. We teach what works within Amazon's rules.

faq: Yes, one-to-one or with your own team. Calls take place on video, and we do not share your account details. You get recordings for your team only.
Do you need access to my account?
Not for teaching, but it is more useful if you share your screen or give view access. We then use your real listings and ad reports as examples.
What level do I need to be?
Any. We start from where you are, whether you have never opened Campaign Manager or you run ads already. Tell us your level in the order form and we plan the first call around it.
It gives your team skills and a clear method, but results depend on your product, price and competition. We do not teach tricks that break Amazon rules, such as review or ranking manipulation.
